content:
amy: kicking off change-window deploy for stable/2026-03-21-canary. staged ramp to 20% across global routes, monitoring p95/error budget for 15m. please stand by and call out anything odd.

deploy-bot: deploy started · preflight monitors -> https://dash.redwood/inflight/1770000000 · target p95 <= 320ms · error_budget healthy threshold = 98% · posting 60s summaries.

infra-ops: I'll watch token-buckets + circuit-breakers in eu-central and eu-west. keeping an eye on refill rates.

raj: quick heads-up: eu-central p95 spiking to ~780ms at +3m. also seeing an uptick in 500s on quant-runner pods.

sara: are those 5xx from the worker or proxy? any 429s showing?

raj: mix of both. proxy 429s start once worker queues fill. sample from host logs: ```[2026-03-21T12:09:45Z] worker-5 kubelet: ERROR generate: oom in quant-kernel alloc \n[2026-03-21T12:09:46Z] proxy-3 rate-limiter: 429 token_bucket_exhausted qlen=120```

amy: pausing the ramp. do NOT push more traffic. propose a regional pin: eu-central -> revert to v2026-03-14 (non-quant) while we triage. keeps other regions healthy.

mike: +1. safer than full rollback. command to pin: `deployctl set-traffic --region eu-central --route stable --version v2026-03-14 --force`

mike: running the pin now...

deploy-bot: traffic policy change requested by mike · applying...

deploy-bot: traffic policy applied · eu-central: pinned -> v2026-03-14 (0% to canary) · global staged ramp lowered -> 5% · change link: https://deploy.redwood/changes/1770000000

infra-ops: verified token-bucket config in eu-central was at 50 qps per shard due to an old override. bumping temporary refill to 80 qps and restarting limiter daemons to drain queues.

raj: after pin + limiter bump, eu-central p95 back down to ~280ms and 5xx rate dropped. queues are draining.

amy: good. action items: raj = collect full pod logs + flamegraphs for quant kernel alloc; infra-ops = add a canary-specific token-bucket rule and review refill policy; sara = draft release note and add change-window entry.

sara: opening GH issue now with logs/screenshots and tagging oncall + infra. GH #4332 created: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/4332

mike: added an entry in the deploy runbook: "do not resume global ramp until quant kernel memory regression fixed and bench perf validated".

amy: we'll hold for 30m of green metrics before considering a slow resume to 10% in non-impacted regions. post any test ramps here.

raj: capturing metric snapshots and uploading to the GH issue. also saving the host-level coredumps and oom traces.

sara: drafting release-note line: "Partial pin in eu-central during change window due to quantized kernel memory pressure; rollback applied and limiter adjusted; investigation in GH #4332."

mike: :thumbsup: nice quick response.

opsbot: note: pinned stable route in eu-central to v2026-03-14 by mike at 2026-03-21T12:11:55Z.

amy: thanks team. once we have the RCA we'll add details to the postmortem and update the changelog.

(quiet)
